additional_concerns: node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e places offering in Scope; node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 place promotional linkage in Scope. False therefore returns OUT_OF_SCOPE instead of the typed question's negative Boolean. node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5 similarly returns OUT_OF_SCOPE outside linked promotion. A deliberately narrower assessment domain is possible but is not established by the questions.

The two offer-level candidates combine offer-level promotional linkage with an existential non-discount gift without explicitly requiring the same component to bear that linkage. Mixed-purpose offers could be overincluded unless the supplied classifications establish this connection.
The SFC-authorised-fund limitation follows the circular's local distributor definition. It does not establish the exhaustive scope of paragraph 3.11, quoted in broader investment-product terms.

Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to FAQ question 1 issued on 30 September 2010 are identified but not supplied externally. Their applicable texts are needed to verify the complete gift standard; no external dependency IDs are supplied.

Gift status, discount status and offer attribution remain supplied judgments. Guaranteed returns are not automatically gifts. The circular does not independently resolve all funding and fulfilment qualifications in node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b; provider terminology in node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249 must not introduce an additional funding requirement.
Passing the selected gift control grants no general permission under section 103, disclosure requirements or advertising rules. Statutory authorisation or exemption is not a stated gift exception.

Footnote 1 is supplied, contrary to the disclosure claim's uncertainty annotation. The extracted disclosure duty is supported but does not exhaust the accompanying principal-loss disclosure requirement.

The advertising-authority dispute concerns necessity: the circular expressly states the narrow instruction, while the Advertising Guidelines, supplements and Code paragraph 2.3 are absent externally. Whether those additional texts are necessary to qualify this narrow instruction remains unresolved.
No operative date interval is established by the supplied source. Runtime temporal safeguards do not establish the applicable legal version.
These scoped NOT_APPLICABLE findings neither certify the gift formulas nor authorize removing separate statutory, disclosure or advertising controls.
